description: A real Front Shared Inbox API skill for managed-OAuth access to conversations, messages, contacts, inboxes, teammates, tags, and rules for team-based customer support collaboration.
authorization_notes: Sending replies from a shared inbox represents the whole team; confirm conversation context and intended reply content with the user before sending.
Assignee changes transfer conversation ownership; confirm the target teammate and reason with the user.
Contact management (create, update, merge) modifies the shared CRM; confirm new handles and merge targets before executing.
Tagging conversations affects team workflows and automated routing; confirm tag assignments with the user.
